summaries: A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Balance Sheets list Total Assets as $142,365 for December 31, 2022, and $3,340 for December 31, 2021. Regarding the requested 2023 to 2024 asset growth calculation, this document does not contain the financial statements for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2023, or 2024; it provides only the 2022 baseline figures, meaning the specific data points required for the 2023-2024 growth computation are not available in this filing.

A Form 10-K annual report for Arvana Inc. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: It reports total assets of $216,549 as of December 31, 2023, and $142,365 for the prior year 2022. This provides the 2023 baseline necessary for the requested 2023-to-2024 asset growth calculation, though the document does not contain the 2024 financial statements required to determine the ending asset value for the growth period.
